title: One Canonical Finalizer, One Write, Execution-Path Parity

A1.label: One finalizer across all paths
A1.description: All execution paths (main, fast, retry, resume, FinalizePipelineOutput) call canonicalFinalize(). No path may independently format, persist, or mark completion.

A2.label: Missing prerequisites block completion
A2.description: The finalizer refuses to proceed when required checkpoint keys are absent or have non-complete status. For contradiction_check: claims_ledger, reconciliation, canonical_findings. For other modules: canonical_findings only.

A3.label: Exactly one durable write
A3.description: Fresh run → one INSERT. Existing incomplete → one UPDATE. Idempotent → zero writes. Completion mark always AFTER artifact persist. Semantic hash stored in module_runs.
invariants: run is never marked completed before artifact is durably written
idempotent retry with identical content is a no-op
retry with different content against completed run is REJECTED

A4.label: Report/API/export parity
A4.description: The report, API output, and export all derive from the same reportable finding set. Semantic hash is insertion-order-insensitive and excludes volatile fields.

A5.label: Diagnostics cannot become findings
A5.description: §F filter ensures process objects, housekeeping, placeholders, degraded notices, and unlinked items never appear as substantive findings in the report.

save_module_result_guard.description: §D guard: SaveModuleResult checks if run already has semantic_hash before writing. If canonically finalized, skips upsertModuleOutput entirely. Only updates documents_included.
save_module_result_guard.condition: runStatus === 'completed' AND existingOutput.semantic_hash IS NOT NULL
save_module_result_guard.action: return existing output_id, skip duplicate write
